answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 41120 Country: India Title: I want to start a gym Question: I want to start a gym. Is the earning halal? Answer ID: 41120 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1272/842/H=1433) If it does not bear any unlawful, haram, makrooh or sinful act then it is lawful and the income earned thereby shall be halal provided any vicious and null dealing is not done. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
